result.summary: The home screen is generally polished; the only notable visual defect is the last category chip being cut off mid-label ("Healthy"), which looks like a layout/clipping issue.

issues.description: The last visible category chip is clipped so only “Healthy” is fully shown and the next chip is cut off mid-character at the right edge, making the filter row look unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent end padding on the chip scroller (or fade/peek the last chip) so the last fully visible chip isn’t cropped through its label.
